decks.notes: This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It includes a combination of mana acceleration cards, creatures that can help ramp, and control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats while also having answers to their threats through cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to control the game early on and then dominate with its huge Eldrazi creatures in the late game.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and Green Sun's Zenith to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It uses control elements like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Disciple of Freyalise and Mosswort Bridge help to generate additional mana and card advantage. The deck also includes board wipes like Malevolent Rumble and Fight Rigging to deal with threats on the opponent's side of the battlefield.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies, aiming to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Voice of Victory. The deck also includes removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board, while Ranger-Captain of Eos can help tutor for key creatures. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides a powerful late-game threat, while cards like Dalkovan Encampment and Goblin Bombardment offer additional utility and reach. Overall, the deck seeks to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and other disruptive cards to hinder the opponent's strategy. The deck utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate card advantage and slow down the opponent's pace. With a mix of permission spells, board wipes, and efficient creatures, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and eventually win through card advantage and incremental advantage. The companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, provides additional value and synergy with the deck's creature base.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing cards that support a quick and powerful offensive strategy. It includes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, as well as removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to control the board. The deck also features cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory, which provide additional support and buffs to further enhance the aggressive nature of the deck. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless assault while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on using ramp and control elements to quickly summon powerful Eldrazi creatures onto the battlefield. The combination of ramp spells and mana dorks accelerates the deck's ability to cast high-cost Eldrazi like Emrakul and Ulamog. Control elements like Ugin's Labyrinth and Malevolent Rumble help disrupt opponents' strategies, while cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Slumbering Trudge provide additional support. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its massive Eldrazi threats while controlling the game's pace to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and then use cards like Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back into play for a surprise attack. Cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending help with card draw and graveyard manipulation, while cards like Solitude provide removal and protection. The goal is to combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond, using instant reanimation to bring out big threats and win the game.

This deck focuses on efficiently using non-land cards to disrupt the opponent while setting up for a powerful combo finish with Goblin Charbelcher. By controlling the opponent's resources with cards like Suppression Ray and Sink into Stupor, as well as countering key spells with cards like Disrupting Shoal and Force of Negation, the deck aims to buy enough time to find and resolve the Goblin Charbelcher combo for a game-winning blast of damage. The deck also includes card draw and deck manipulation to help find combo pieces and maintain consistency.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and mana acceleration to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and threats. By combining cards like Mox Opal, Mishra's Bauble, and Urza's Saga with powerful creatures such as Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Kappa Cannoneer, the deck is able to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Engineered Explosives and Claws of Gix provide additional removal options, while Pinnacle Emissary and Weapons Manufacturing offer versatility in combat situations. Overall, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and close out the game quickly through a combination of efficient threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing blink effects to repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities of creatures like Solitude, Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, and Quantum Riddler. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Prismatic Ending to control the board while setting up for aggressive plays. Teferi, Time Raveler allows for instant-speed plays and protects key pieces from removal. The mana base is designed to support a mix of white, blue, and black cards, ensuring the deck can consistently cast its spells and maintain tempo advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Dredge mechanic to fill the graveyard with cards such as Golgari Thug and Stinkweed Imp, allowing for the recursion of powerful creatures like Arclight Phoenix. The deck also includes burn spells like Lava Dart and Burning Inquiry to disrupt the opponent while setting up the graveyard engine. Other cards like Creeping Chill provide additional value when dredged, and Faithless Looting helps filter through the deck to find key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble powerful combos and overwhelm the opponent with a mix of graveyard recursion and burn damage.

The main idea of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana using cards like Desperate Ritual, Pyretic Ritual, and Ruby Medallion, and then use that mana to cast powerful spells like Grapeshot and Past in Flames to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Wrenn's Resolve and Ral, Monsoon Mage to protect your combo pieces and generate card advantage. Additionally, cards like Valakut Awakening and Wish provide flexibility and card selection to ensure the combo goes off smoothly.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategies by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption tools like Thoughtseize. By effectively controlling the flow of the game, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent in the late game with powerful threats like Psychic Frog and Harbinger of the Seas. The deck also includes graveyard recursion with cards like Unearth to provide additional value and versatility. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to exert control over the game and grind out incremental advantages to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Broodscale Bloodchief combo using cards like Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief. This combo allows for powerful synergies and strong board presence, while also utilizing powerful spells like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command to control the game. The deck also includes cards like Urza?s Saga and Eldrazi Temple to ramp into the combo pieces quickly, providing a fast and explosive win condition in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on creating a powerful combo using cards like Sowing Mycospawn, Malevolent Rumble, and Emrakul, the Promised End to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Grove of the Burnwillows and Eldrazi Temple to ramp up mana quickly and play big threats early. The inclusion of Kozilek's Command and Ugin's Labyrinth helps to control the board while setting up the combo. Additionally, cards like Vexing Bauble and Ancient Stirrings provide card advantage and consistency. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful board state and finish the game quickly with its combo.

The main concept of this aggro Red Deck Wins deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent through a combination of cheap, efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike. The deck aims to be fast and relentless, utilizing cards like Light Up the Stage and Mishra's Bauble to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. With consistent damage output and the ability to quickly close out games, this deck excels at overpowering opponents before they can establish their own game plan.
